headline: Rates repricing and NVDA CEO exit hit Nasdaq-100 (-1.22%) as hike bets build

what_happened.summary: The Nasdaq-100 closed Fri 13 Nov at 27943.74 (-1.22%) and the S&P 500 at 7561.67 (-0.40%), so tech again fell more than the broad index. The Treasury curve sold off: the 10-year closed at 5.15% (+5.0 bp) and the 2-year at 4.88% (+2.0 bp). Polymarket (prediction-market prices, not CME FedWatch) puts a 25 bps December hike at 86.5% and a 50+ bps hike at 9.2%. An NVIDIA 8-K (primary source) says CEO Jen-Hsun Huang resigned effective immediately, with CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO. Volatility rose on the day: VIX 19.3, VXN 29.38, VVIX 101.53.
what_happened.market_action: Nasdaq-100 -1.22% vs S&P 500 -0.40% on 13 Nov. Over the past 10 sessions the Nasdaq-100 swung widely: -6.36% on 5 Nov, +3.40% on 9 Nov and +2.28% on 11 Nov. VIX closed 19.3 (+3.21%), VXN 29.38 (+2.91%), VVIX 101.53 (+4.98%), SKEW 147.14 (-2.01%). COR1M rose to 11.8 (+18.12%), but its 10-day range is 9.79 to 20.76. High-yield OAS was 3.2 pct pts on 12 Nov (-10.0 bp), so credit is not confirming stress. FRED oil data stops at 11 Nov (Brent 92.14, WTI 89.62), well below the 30 Oct Brent of 120.15.
what_happened.macro: BLS October prints (primary): CPI m/m 0.35% (prior 0.65%), core CPI 0.3% (prior 0.33%), PPI final demand m/m 0.35% (prior 1.41%) and y/y 6.52%, PPI ex food, energy and trade y/y 4.86%. Unemployment was 4.1% (prior 4.2) and payrolls rose 165.0k. September core PCE was 3.12% y/y. Yields have risen sharply over the past week: the 2-year went from 4.46% on 5 Nov to 4.88%, and the 10-year real yield was 2.86% on 12 Nov (+8.0 bp). 10-year breakeven was 2.24% (+0.0 bp), so the rise is in real yields, not inflation compensation. Engine read: markets are pricing a hiking cycle that is still running, which pressures long-duration equities.
what_happened.geopolitics: not covered by the sources beyond unverified headlines (for example an oil headline about ongoing negotiations). Nothing there can be treated as fact.
what_happened.company_news: NVDA 8-K filed 12 Nov: Huang resigned as President, CEO and director, Kress is interim CEO, and the board is searching for a successor. Headlines (unverified) say analysts downgraded NVDA, that NVDA and the Nasdaq went oversold, and that options price a 9% earnings swing for NVDA's report this week. META filed an 8-K on 12 Nov for a euro notes offering in six tranches, with coupons from 4.300% (2031) to 6.400% (2065). Engine read: heavy long-dated issuance by a mega-cap adds to the supply and term-premium narrative; the filing does not state a purpose.

driver_reason: The 2-year, 10-year and 30-year yields all rose on 13 Nov (+2.0, +5.0, +4.0 bp), the 10-year real yield is up sharply since 9 Nov, and Polymarket prices a 25 bps December hike at 86.5% with a further 9.2% on a 50+ bps hike. The NVDA CEO exit is a large single-stock overlay on the Nasdaq-100, but rates are the common backdrop across the last two weeks.
leader_reason: The Nasdaq-100 minus S&P 500 was -0.82 pct pts last session, with VXN minus VIX at 10.08 pts, so Nasdaq-100 volatility is priced well above the S&P's. The 5-session gap is +1.03 pct pts, so QQQ led the rebound and then the pullback; it is the higher-beta index in both directions. COR1M at 11.8 is low, which suggests stock-specific moves rather than a broad market move.

scenarios.text: A choppy session within roughly +/-0.9% while the market waits for Warsh and Tuesday's retail sales.

memory_update.running_thesis: Rates and a hiking Fed (Polymarket: 25 bps December hike 86.5%) are the main macro backdrop. The 10-year is at 5.15% and the real yield is rising. Nasdaq-100 is the higher-beta index (VXN minus VIX 10.08) and fell 1.22% on 13 Nov versus 0.40% for the S&P. NVDA CEO Huang resigned (8-K), a large single-stock overlay before NVDA earnings. Credit (HY OAS 3.2) shows no stress. Oil fell sharply from late October (stale data).
open_questions: Does the NVDA CEO change alter the earnings reaction?
Will retail sales and FOMC minutes harden the December hike path?
Is the 5 Nov Nasdaq-100 drop of 6.36% fully digested?
